integrity: An exact quadratic Lyapunov identity and projection monotonicity prove global convergence for interior coordinates at dimensionless steps below one. A nondecaying companion recurrence rules out every other interior initialization at or above one; exact six-cycles witness the boundary. Active coordinates converge for all positive steps, with finite termination under strict complementarity. A standalone standard-library checker corroborates symbolic identities and rational witnesses.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic fixed one-step stale projected full-gradient iteration in exact arithmetic, diagonal positive-definite quadratic and nonnegative orthant, any finite dimension. Excludes coupled Hessians, variable delays, stochastic coordinate choice, and floating-point effects. The supplied contraction rate is sufficient; the convergence interval is sharp.
title: Sharp active-face stepsize law for one-lag projected gradient on separable quadratics
